 assert conformance.attrib['tests']=='46' and conformance.attrib['failures']=='0' and conformance.attrib['errors']=='0' and conformance.attrib['skipped']=='23',conformance.attrib

try:

 artifacts=[dict(r) for r in con.execute("SELECT json_extract(record,'$.project_id') AS project_id,json_extract(record,'$.source_path') AS source_path,json_extract(record,'$.size') AS size,json_extract(record,'$.sha256') AS sha256 FROM artifacts LIMIT 30")];assert all(r['project_id']=='conformance' for r in artifacts)

(out/'post-check-state.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n');shutil.copyfile(lab/'evidence/conformance-environments.json',out/'conformance-environments.json')
shutil.copyfile('/tmp/sandbox-lab23-envs.py',out/'envs-final.py');shutil.copyfile('/tmp/sandbox-lab23-state.py',out/'state-check.py')

secrets=[p.read_bytes().strip() for p in (lab/'worker').glob('*.token')]
for p in out.iterdir():
 if p.is_file():
